# defectdojo_system_settings (Resource)

DefectDojo System Settings.

**Singleton**: `terraform apply` adopts the existing system settings row and updates it. `terraform destroy` only removes it from Terraform state — settings keep their last-applied values. Only attributes set in configuration are managed; unset attributes retain their server-side values.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Singleton resource: DefectDojo always has exactly one system_settings row.
# `terraform apply` adopts that existing row (there is no create/destroy on
# the API - only List and Update/PartialUpdate) and updates it in place.
# `terraform destroy` only forgets it in Terraform state; the settings keep
# their last-applied values on the server.
#
# Only attributes you set below are managed by Terraform - any attribute you
# omit keeps whatever value is already configured in DefectDojo.
resource "defectdojo_system_settings" "example" {
  team_name        = "Example Security Team"
  disclaimer_notes = "Internal use only."

  enable_deduplication = true
  delete_duplicates    = true
  max_dupes            = 5

  enable_finding_sla         = true
  engagement_auto_close      = true
  engagement_auto_close_days = 3

  # jira_minimum_severity = "High"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `add_vulnerability_id_to_jira_label` (Boolean) Add the vulnerability ID as a label when pushing findings to Jira.
- `allow_anonymous_survey_repsonse` (Boolean) Enable anyone with a link to the survey to answer a survey.
- `api_expose_error_details` (Boolean) When turned on, the API will expose error details in the response.
- `delete_duplicates` (Boolean) Requires next setting: maximum number of duplicates to retain.
- `disable_jira_webhook_secret` (Boolean) Allows incoming requests without a secret (discouraged legacy behaviour).
- `disclaimer_notes` (String) Include this custom disclaimer next to input form for notes.
- `disclaimer_notifications` (String) Include this custom disclaimer on all notifications.
- `disclaimer_reports` (String) Include this custom disclaimer on generated reports.
- `disclaimer_reports_forced` (Boolean) Disclaimer will be added to all reports even if user didn't select 'Include disclaimer'.
- `email_from` (String) The From address used for outgoing DefectDojo email notifications.
- `enable_benchmark` (Boolean) Enables Benchmarks such as the OWASP ASVS (Application Security Verification Standard).
- `enable_calendar` (Boolean) With this setting turned off, the Calendar will be disabled in the user interface.
- `enable_checklists` (Boolean) With this setting turned off, checklists will be disabled in the user interface.
- `enable_cvss3_display` (Boolean) With this setting turned off, CVSS3 fields will be hidden in the user interface.
- `enable_cvss4_display` (Boolean) With this setting turned off, CVSS4 fields will be hidden in the user interface.
- `enable_deduplication` (Boolean) With this setting turned on, DefectDojo deduplicates findings by comparing endpoints, cwe fields, and titles. If two findings share a URL and have the same CWE or title, DefectDojo marks the recent finding as a duplicate. When deduplication is enabled, a list of deduplicated findings is added to the engagement view.
- `enable_endpoint_metadata_import` (Boolean) With this setting turned off, endpoint metadata import will be disabled in the user interface.
- `enable_finding_groups` (Boolean) With this setting turned off, the Finding Groups will be disabled.
- `enable_finding_sla` (Boolean) Enables Finding SLA's for time to remediate.
- `enable_github` (Boolean) Enables linking DefectDojo findings to Github issues.
- `enable_jira` (Boolean) Enables JIRA integration.
- `enable_jira_web_hook` (Boolean) Please note: It is strongly recommended to use a secret and / or IP whitelist the JIRA server using a proxy such as Nginx.
- `enable_mail_notifications` (Boolean) Enables email notifications.
- `enable_msteams_notifications` (Boolean) Enables Microsoft Teams notifications.
- `enable_notify_sla_active` (Boolean) Enables Notify when time to remediate according to Finding SLA's is breached for active Findings.
- `enable_notify_sla_active_verified` (Boolean) Enables Notify when time to remediate according to Finding SLA's is breached for active, verified Findings.
- `enable_notify_sla_exponential_backoff` (Boolean) Enable an exponential backoff strategy for SLA breach notifications, e.g. 1, 2, 4, 8, etc. Otherwise it alerts every day.
- `enable_notify_sla_jira_only` (Boolean) Enables Notify when time to remediate according to Finding SLA's is breached for Findings that are linked to JIRA issues. Notification is disabled for Findings not linked to JIRA issues.
- `enable_product_grade` (Boolean) Displays a grade letter next to a product to show the overall health.
- `enable_product_tag_inheritance` (Boolean) Enable product tag inheritance for every product on the instance. DefectDojo copies each tag on a product to all its Engagements, Tests and Findings. It writes the tags onto the child objects, and it adds them again if you remove them. Every Terraform-managed `defectdojo_engagement` and `defectdojo_test` must therefore list its product's tags in its own `tags`. If one does not, the apply fails, because the server reports tags that the configuration did not ask for.
- `enable_product_tracking_files` (Boolean) With this setting turned off, the product tracking files will be disabled in the user interface.
- `enable_questionnaires` (Boolean) With this setting turned off, questionnaires will be disabled in the user interface.
- `enable_similar_findings` (Boolean) Enable the query of similar findings on the view finding page. This feature can involve potentially large queries and negatively impact performance.
- `enable_slack_notifications` (Boolean) Enables Slack notifications.
- `enable_ui_table_based_searching` (Boolean) With this setting enabled, table headings will contain sort buttons for the current page of data in addition to sorting buttons that consider data from all pages.
- `enable_user_profile_editable` (Boolean) When turned on users can edit their profiles.
- `enable_webhooks_notifications` (Boolean) Enables outgoing webhook notifications.
- `enforce_verified_status` (Boolean) When enabled, features such as product grading, jira integration, metrics, and reports will only interact with verified findings. This setting will override individually scoped verified toggles.
- `enforce_verified_status_jira` (Boolean) When enabled, findings must have a verified status to be pushed to jira.
- `enforce_verified_status_metrics` (Boolean) When enabled, findings must have a verified status to be counted in metric calculations, be included in reports, and filters.
- `enforce_verified_status_product_grading` (Boolean) When enabled, findings must have a verified status to be considered as part of a product's grading.
- `engagement_auto_close` (Boolean) Closes an engagement after 3 days (default) past due date including last update.
- `engagement_auto_close_days` (Number) Closes an engagement after the specified number of days past due date including last update.
- `false_positive_history` (Boolean) (EXPERIMENTAL) DefectDojo will automatically mark the finding as a false positive if an equal finding (according to its dedupe algorithm) has been previously marked as a false positive on the same product. ATTENTION: Although the deduplication algorithm is used to determine if a finding should be marked as a false positive, this feature will not work if deduplication is enabled since it doesn't make sense to use both.
- `filter_string_matching` (Boolean) When turned on, all filter operations in the UI will require string matches rather than ID. This is a performance enhancement to avoid fetching objects unnecessarily.
- `jira_labels` (String) JIRA issue labels space separated.
- `jira_minimum_severity` (String) Minimum severity level for pushing findings to JIRA. Valid values are: 'Critical', 'High', 'Medium', 'Low', 'Info'.
- `jira_webhook_secret` (String, Sensitive) Secret needed in URL for incoming JIRA Webhook.
- `lowercase_character_required` (Boolean) Requires user passwords to contain at least one lowercase letter (a-z).
- `mail_notifications_to` (String) Recipient address for global mail notifications.
- `max_dupes` (Number) When enabled, if a single issue reaches the maximum number of duplicates, the oldest will be deleted. Duplicate will not be deleted when left empty. A value of 0 will remove all duplicates.
- `maximum_password_length` (Number) Requires user to set passwords less than maximum length.
- `minimum_password_length` (Number) Requires user to set passwords greater than minimum length.
- `msteams_url` (String) The full URL of the incoming webhook.
- `non_common_password_required` (Boolean) Requires user passwords to not be part of list of common passwords.
- `number_character_required` (Boolean) Requires user passwords to contain at least one digit (0-9).
- `product_grade_a` (Number) Percentage score for an 'A' >=.
- `product_grade_b` (Number) Percentage score for a 'B' >=.
- `product_grade_c` (Number) Percentage score for a 'C' >=.
- `product_grade_d` (Number) Percentage score for a 'D' >=.
- `product_grade_f` (Number) Percentage score for an 'F' <=.
- `retroactive_false_positive_history` (Boolean) (EXPERIMENTAL) FP History will also retroactively mark/unmark all existing equal findings in the same product as a false positives. Only works if the False Positive History feature is also enabled.
- `risk_acceptance_form_default_days` (Number) Default expiry period for risk acceptance form.
- `risk_acceptance_notify_before_expiration` (Number) Notify X days before risk acceptance expires. Leave empty to disable.
- `slack_channel` (String) Optional. Needed if you want to send global notifications.
- `slack_token` (String, Sensitive) Token required for interacting with Slack. Get one at https://api.slack.com/tokens.
- `slack_username` (String) Optional. Will take your bot name otherwise.
- `special_character_required` (Boolean) Requires user passwords to contain at least one special character (e.g. !@#$%^&*).
- `team_name` (String) The name of the team/organization, displayed in the DefectDojo UI.
- `uppercase_character_required` (Boolean) Requires user passwords to contain at least one uppercase letter (A-Z).
- `url_prefix` (String) URL prefix if DefectDojo is installed in it's own virtual subdirectory.
- `webhooks_notifications_timeout` (Number) How many seconds will DefectDojo waits for response from webhook endpoint.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import defectdojo_system_settings.example 1
```
